title: Remote Work Policy
text: Team members may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Everyone should be reachable during the shared collaboration window from 10:00 to 15:00. Requests for fully remote arrangements are reviewed separately.

title: Annual Leave Guide
text: Full-time team members receive twenty-five paid vacation days each calendar year. Leave requests should normally be submitted at least two weeks before the first day away.

title: Account Support
text: For a locked account, contact the help desk and include the device name. Support will verify identity before resetting access. Never send a password through chat or email.
